name: Morzomotha & Karst Deeps
theme: Subterranean Karst, Sunless Libraries & Delver Pits (Cursed Scroll 5)
hazardTable: Falling stalactites from subterranean tremors (DC 13 DEX or 2d8 damage)
Bioluminescent spore puff (DC 12 CON or hallucinatory visions)
Chasm rope bridge snapping (DC 14 DEX to catch ledge)
Flooded cave siphon rush (DC 12 STR or swept 1 chamber down)
weatherTable: Stagnant cool air dripping with limestone mineral water
Dense humid cave mist hanging over underground pools
Frozen flowstone cascades in upper passages

factions.name: Deep Delver Guild
factions.notes: Map subterranean corridors, secure profitable silver lodes, and maintain rescue routes to the surface.

factions.name: Librarians of Leng
factions.notes: Guard occult manuscripts from surface barbarians and preserve cosmic secrets in darkness.

factions.name: Karst Troglodyte Packs
factions.notes: Defend their mushroom beds, acquire iron scrap, and ambush careless travelers lacking light.

uniqueFloraFauna: Pure mineral seepage collected in clean stone basins
Imported smoked meats, iron rations, and cultivated glow-lichen paste
entryConditions: Expedition access point into Morzomotha & Karst Deeps.
exitConditions: Waymarked return route to Upper Sink Refuge.
